The question asks who performed the lead single on the album *Friends in Low Places*, *No Fences*, that reached #1 on Billboard.  
From the source [Friends in Low Places], the song "Friends in Low Places" was performed by Garth Brooks, released as the lead single from his album *No Fences*, and spent four weeks at number one on the Hot Country Songs chart.  
The source [No Fences] confirms this is Garth Brooks' album.  

Final answer: Garth Brooks
